title: Grayhaven Conversational Technologies
text:
Grayhaven Conversational Technologies

['9/12: inbound lead via website contact form (Product) - interested in faster chat for customer service', '9/19: intro call (Maya + Carlos) - overview of Redwood hosted vs dedicated. Grayhaven wants predictable P50 latency <150ms for chat; throughput 120 reqs/sec peak. Cost sensitive - target < $0.08 per 1k tokens net after batching. Wants embeddings for search rerank.', '10/03: discovery workshop (zoom) - invited security and infra. We captured detailed requirements: SSO (SAML), retention controls, SOC2 report, ability to run private deployment in GCP us-east1. SE asked for sample traffic profile + POC dataset.', '10/12: security questionnaire sent (link to drive doc). SE delivered draft POC plan and sizing. Pricing deck v2 shared. AE noted: "they liked the routing/fallback story".', '10/24: follow-up call for legal/pricing - finance asked for committed vs usage cost scenarios. Estimated ARR range discussed (50k-200k).', "11/01: POC scoping email - asked for test fixtures and credentials. Grayhaven product lead said they'd get infra team to return questionnaire by 11/08.", '11/09: went dark - no questionnaire returned. Multiple touchpoints from AE/SE (email, LinkedIn). Reply from product lead on 11/15: "budget paused until Q2 FY25", then silence.', '11/27: Maya left voicemail; Carlos sent technical checklist (kv cache, quantization guidance). No response.', '11/28: last activity recorded - automated nurture email opened.', '12/05: AE status update: mark as stalled in CRM; maintain quarterly re-touch. Notes: security team flagged KMS/HSM requirement as potential blocker; no clear champion after org reorg last month.', "Key quotes: 'We need SOC2 and SSO answered before any POC' — Head of Security. 'Cost model needs to be clear vs our current vendor' — VP Product.", 'Actions taken: pricing scenarios + public-cloud dedicated option shared; SE prepared a trimmed POC to run on hosted API to reduce time to value; security FAQ link shared. No uptake yet.', 'Recommended cadence: 90-day reengage, touch with product ROI memo, ask for updated sponsorship and timeline.']
